parameter.name: left
parameter.label: Left Wheel Value
parameter.description: Signed value from -1000 to 1000 for the left wheel.

parameter.name: right
parameter.label: Right Wheel Value
parameter.description: Signed value from -1000 to 1000 for the right wheel.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.label: Drive Timeout
parameter.description: Duration of the wheel command in milliseconds, from 1 to 5000.

parameter.name: remoteStart
parameter.label: Remote Start
parameter.description: The location to start the mowing job from.

parameter.name: afterMode
parameter.label: After Job Mode
parameter.description: The Mode to put the mower into after the job is done.

parameter.name: start
parameter.label: Job Start Time
parameter.description: The time at which the job starts, in HH:mm format.

parameter.name: end
parameter.label: Job End Time
parameter.description: The time at which the job ends, in HH:mm format.
